title: Exact full-injection one-sided quenched D6 expectation from original 60-fibre tensor

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
any fixed complete ORIGINAL point-source globally injective physical pair-label assignment
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original line map, shared over all original Q and all 60 positional cycles

statement: For every h>=1 and fixed complete globally injected original point map f, set T_f=sum_{H in 60 labelled C6}sum_{Q in Q_AA} A_f(H,Q), with the exact original six incidence-ID source conditions. With V=(s+1)(s^2+1), minimal physical alphabet a, K=binom(a,2)>=V, one complete independently uniformly random globally injective original line map g yields exact E_g[D6(f,g)|f]=((a)_6/(K)_6)*T_f. All g-images of six distinct original lines have the ordered injective six-pair marginal, and the same full g is shared across all Q so no pairwise independence of candidate events is asserted.
external_dependencies: Exactly (a)_6 globally extendible line-label coordinate assignments realize the SAME fixed labelled original six-column C6 on six distinct original source line IDs.
Uniform ordered six-label marginal of ONE complete globally injected g from K physical unordered edges.
limitations: Strict positivity of E_g D6 for fixed f is not a pointwise positive lower for an adversarially selected g.
This extends the exact conditional counting domain to h>=1 but does not override the stronger h>=3 constant in AA4R.
The tensor fibres are correlated under one g; no Chernoff or concentration bound is claimed.
falsification_boundary: Use one full global right map g sampled once, not independent per Q or per H; source incidence columns must be identical on both coordinate-dual sides.
